text:
alex: FYI customer (Acme Corp) is seeing streaming chat cut off after ~20s. Client gets partial JSON/event then reconnect loop. Happens on prod domain behind Cloudflare + GKE nginx ingress + ALB. Ticket #ACME-782.
maria: Any error traces? client headers? 5xx from our side?
alex: Paste from ingress error log (nginx):
```
2026/03/16 14:12:07 [error] 1234#1234: *5678 upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.1.2.3, server: _, request: "GET /stream?session=abcd HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://10.2.3.4:8080/", host: "prod.example.com"
```
No 5xx from app side, just EOF on upstream read.
chris: Sounds like buffering/coalescing or a proxy idle/half-close. Cloudflare can buffer and also rewrite encodings. NGINX with gzip on will buffer small writes. For SSE you want unbuffered passthrough.
alex: Repro I ran locally with curl:
```
curl -v -N https://prod.example.com/stream -H 'Accept: text/event-stream'
```
Output shows 1-2 events then `Connection reset by peer` around 22s.
maria: Does it reproduce if you bypass Cloudflare (direct to ALB)?
alex: Bypassed Cloudflare -> direct to ALB/GKE ingress -> stream is stable.
chris: Ok that points at Cloudflare or something on the edge. Quick checklist for SSE:
- disable gzip/content compression on path
- set `proxy_buffering off;` in nginx for /stream
- ensure `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` and flush after each event
- add `Cache-Control: no-transform` so intermediaries don't change chunking

alex: We tried disabling gzip at app and turned off ingress gzip module; set `proxy_buffering off` for the path. Still hit truncation when Cloudflare in front. Bypassing CF = stable.
chris: Cloudflare has an upstream timeout (100s) normally, but the immediate truncation suggests CF might be buffering chunks until a gzip block completes, or it's coalescing small writes and then failing on connection semantics. `no-transform` helps. Also ALB idle timeout might cause issues if there are long pauses, but you said it fails at 20s.
maria: Another test: set response header `Content-Encoding: identity` and `Cache-Control: no-transform`, and in app call `res.flush()` after every SSE message. Can you try that and share curl output + ingress logs?
alex: Tried that sequence. With `Content-Encoding: identity` + `Cache-Control: no-transform` + explicit flushes, Cloudflare->prod stream stayed up for 6+ minutes in my test. Before the change I saw the `upstream prematurely closed` log; after it went away.
alex: Sample minimal repro we used (Node):
```js
// minimal SSE server
const http = require('http');
http.createServer((req,res)=>{
  res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':'text/event-stream','Cache-Control':'no-transform','Content-Encoding':'identity','Connection':'keep-alive'});
  let i=0;
  const t=setInterval(()=>{
    res.write(`id: ${i}\nevent: message\ndata: {\"n\":${i}}\n\n`);
    if(res.flush) res.flush(); // express/nginx-friendly flush
    i++; if(i>100) clearInterval(t);
  },1000);
}).listen(8080);
```
Use `curl -v -N` to observe real-time chunks.
chris: Great. For the support KB we should capture quick remediation steps so support can triage faster:
- If truncation occurs and bypassing edge fixes it -> suspect Cloudflare/edge buffering.
- Check for `upstream prematurely closed` in ingress logs.
- Ensure SSE paths have `proxy_buffering off` on nginx ingress + disable gzip for that route.
- Add `Cache-Control: no-transform` and `Content-Encoding: identity`.
- Use `curl -v -N` and also test direct-to-origin to isolate.
maria: I'll create a follow-up ticket to engineering to consider defaulting to `no-transform` for our SSE endpoints and to warn customers in Console if they enable compression on a route serving `text/event-stream`.
ingress-bot: Deploy note: updated ingress rule `prod-ingress-3` to set `proxy_buffering: "off"` and path-specific annotation to disable gzip for `/stream` paths. Rolling update; ETA 15m.
alex: Customer applied app-side flush + our ingress change. They've confirmed stable connection and no more partial JSON/reconnects. Marking customer ticket resolved pending 24h monitoring.
maria: Adding these steps to support runbook now. :white_check_mark:
